scripts.db:migrate: pnpm --filter api exec prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:seed: pnpm --filter api exec prisma db seed
scripts.prepare: pnpm --filter @growspark/shared build && pnpm --filter api exec prisma generate
scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @growspark/shared build && pnpm --filter api exec prisma generate && pnpm -r --parallel dev
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @growspark/shared build && pnpm --filter api exec prisma generate && pnpm -r build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @growspark/shared build && pnpm --filter api exec prisma generate && pnpm -r typecheck
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @growspark/shared build && pnpm --filter api exec prisma generate && pnpm -r lint
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @growspark/shared build && pnpm --filter api exec prisma generate && pnpm -r test
